## Test Cases

### ✅ Happy Flow
<!-- The system works correctly when given valid inputs and the right actor. -->
- [ ] TC-XX-01: [Actor] [action with valid input] → Expected: [correct outcome]
- [ ] TC-XX-02: [Actor] [another valid scenario] → Expected: [correct outcome]

### ❌ Sad / Error Flow
<!-- Invalid inputs, wrong permissions, missing resources, expired tokens. -->
- [ ] TC-XX-03: [Actor] [action with invalid input] → Expected: [error code + message]
- [ ] TC-XX-04: [Wrong role] attempts [privileged action] → Expected: 403 Forbidden
- [ ] TC-XX-05: [Actor] [action on non-existent resource] → Expected: 404 Not Found
- [ ] TC-XX-06: [Actor] [duplicate entry] → Expected: 409 Conflict

### 🔲 Edge Cases
<!-- Boundary conditions, concurrent requests, empty state, limits, special characters. -->
- [ ] TC-XX-07: [Plan limit boundary] → Expected: [behaviour at limit]
- [ ] TC-XX-08: [Empty state — no records exist] → Expected: [empty array / null / graceful]
- [ ] TC-XX-09: [Concurrent / race condition scenario] → Expected: [idempotent outcome]
- [ ] TC-XX-10: [Max payload / special characters in input] → Expected: [handled gracefully]

## Security / Auth Checks (fill in if auth-related)
- [ ] TC-XX-11: Request with no cookie and no Authorization header → Expected: 401
- [ ] TC-XX-12: Request with expired token → Expected: 401
- [ ] TC-XX-13: XSS check — token not accessible via `localStorage` or `document.cookie` in JS
